summary: Security image updates install faster, and each install reports exactly which images it runs.

new.title: Images reported by the install
new.text: PIM Manager reports which images it runs and their platform version, so a security update can be confirmed on every install.

fixes.title: Faster security image updates
fixes.text: When a release only brings a patched image, PIM Manager swaps the image at once. It no longer waits for running jobs to finish, and your data is not touched.

fixes.title: Old images removed
fixes.text: Once the new image has run successfully, the old image is removed, so security scanners no longer report it.
